# PM AutoTwin Studio

> PM AutoTwin Studio is a 3D asset platform that optimizes heavy CAD and large IFC files and converts them to OpenUSD (Beta) for simulation and digital twins, developed by POCKET MEMORY Inc., a South Korean deep-tech company specializing in 3D digital twin optimization.

## Company
- **Name**: POCKET MEMORY Inc. (주식회사 포켓메모리)
- **Website**: https://studio.pmautotwin.com
- **Industry**: 3D Digital Twin, Asset Management, Industrial AI
- **Location**: Seoul, South Korea

## Product: PM AutoTwin Studio
PM AutoTwin Studio connects three steps in one place:

### PM Create (GEN)
- Generates 3D models from an image input
- Supports rapid prototyping and digital twin creation

### PM Optimize (OPT)
- Opens large design files without splitting them and optimizes the meshes inside
- Keeps hierarchy, names, materials and other metadata where possible
- Converts CAD to OpenUSD (Beta) for simulation pre-processing
- Shows the original and the result side by side for comparison

### PM Hub (HUB)
- 3D asset management: search, reuse and share optimized files with your team
- Secure links with an expiry period

## Standards
- IEEE P3079.5/6 (3D quality measurement and optimization): PAR submission in preparation

## Awards
- 2025 Minister's Award from the Korea Ministry of Science and ICT (World Smart City Expo 2025)

## Deployment Options
- **SaaS**: Use on the web, no install
- **On-Premise**: Install on your own server
